when.quote: This document outlines the step-by-step workflow for agents to process CLI requests, including verification and final decision. These steps MUST be followed in the exact order listed.

starts.note: customer: start only when the account owner or an authorized account manager asks to raise the credit limit on a credit card. No document says the agent may offer an increase without being asked. If a request is denied and the customer asks again in the same conversation (for example after paying the balance down), that is a new customer request: run the resubmit steps. If the customer was already verified earlier in this conversation (for example in a dispute job), do not verify again. If, in the same conversation, the customer has also asked to dispute a charge or replace the same card, and neither has been done yet, tell them that an active dispute or a pending replacement would block the increase, and offer to do the increase first. Follow the order the customer then chooses (plan_order).
starts.quote: Only the account owner or an authorized account manager may submit a CLI request for the account.

The CLI job never files a dispute. A dispute the customer also wants is filed in filing_a_credit_card_transaction_dispute, after the CLI decision if the customer chose to do the CLI first.

jobs.done_when: The customer is verified and logged (in this job or earlier in the conversation). Then one of these holds. (a) The CLI request was submitted within the tier maximum, every criterion was checked, exactly one of the approve or deny tools was called, and the customer was told the decision with its reason and reapply date, or the new limit. For a pending_disputes denial, they were told it can be resubmitted once the dispute is resolved. (b) The customer declined the tier-maximum amount and nothing was submitted. (c) A tool failed after a retry and a transfer was offered. (d) After a denial, the customer fixed the cause (for example paid the balance down through the payment job) and asked again, and a new request was submitted, checked in full and decided, and the customer was told the result. In every case, if the customer also asked for a dispute or replacement on the same card before either was made, they were told first that it would block the CLI and offered the CLI first. If they chose that order, the agent went on to the dispute and replacement jobs after the decision.

args.reason: manual review of the replacement limit

steps.if: the replacement limit is exceeded and the customer agrees to a transfer
steps.quote: If you believe you have a legitimate need for an additional replacement beyond these limits, contact customer support to request a manual review of your case.

rules.rule: No new replacement while one is still being processed.
rules.quote: You cannot submit another replacement while an existing request is still being processed.

rules.rule: Premium tier and above: up to 4 replacements per 60-day period (Entry 2, Mid 3).
rules.quote: Premium-tier and above: up to 4 replacements per period.

rules.rule: Expedited fee: Entry $15.00, Mid $10.00, Premium and above $0.00.
rules.quote: Premium-tier and above (Gold Rewards Card, Business Gold Rewards Card, Platinum Rewards Card, Business Platinum Rewards Card, Diamond Elite Card): $0.00 (complimentary).

rules.rule: Tell the customer the delivery window for the shipping speed they chose.
rules.quote: Communicate the expected delivery window based on the selected method

draft.done_when: Eligibility has been checked; the replacement has been ordered with the confirmed reason, address and shipping speed (or the customer has been told why they are not eligible); and the customer knows the old card is cancelled and when the new one will arrive.
